Below this are black and red text, some in Chinese characters, indicating product details. The tube includes the English phrase "intensive care" beneath the brand name, highlighting its purpose as a deeply moisturizing formula.

Towards the lower half, the cream’s specific benefits are visually represented by a graphic of golden droplets atop a honeycomb-like structure, symbolizing hydration and protection. The details suggest the product is enriched with nourishing ingredients aimed at improving skin health. The packaging mentions "10X" hydration enhancement and caters specifically to hand and nail care.

The bottom features a coral-pink screw cap, complementing the tube's design. Below the cap, “50ml” text is visible, indicating the product quantity. The overall aesthetic is sleek and feminine, aligning with skincare branding. The gray background creates a neutral contrast with the packaging, drawing focus to the product. No characters or celebrities are featured in the image.

groups.title: Shift + 左键 添加正面（绿色）的坐标点。
Shift + 右键 添加负面（红色）的坐标点。
Ctrl + 左键 绘制方框。
右键坐标点 删除该点，不能删除点数组的起点/终点。
要添加图像，选择节点并粘贴或拖入图像。
此为手动调整遮罩，需要先点一下运行，等这个节点获取到第一帧图片后，点击取消运行程序。此时可以设置绿色的坐标点，用来指定需要替换部位的遮罩（此程序只需设置绿色的点）
如果要重新选择点，可以点击界面最下面的new canvas
